00001| // Checking a stated expectation before fixing (PR #1188 T93, gap G14): "Fix
00002| // the bug in m.mjs: add should return the sum." on a correct module fell to
00003| // the unknown answer. A bug report that names a module and states what one of
00004| // its functions should return (the seeded `coding_bug_fix_request` and
00005| // `coding_expectation_cue` meanings, every registered language) is checked
00006| // first: the module is read, the expectation is computed from the statement
00007| // itself at the contract's sample arguments (the calculator, as for an added
00008| // function), the function is run at the same arguments through the
00009| // contract's seeded `probe` command, and the observed value is compared. A
00010| // function that meets the expectation is reported as no defect found, from a
00011| // seeded template; one that does not is reported as confirmed, the file
00012| // unchanged. rust/src/agentic_coding/function_expectation.rs.

00033| const ROLE_BUG_FIX = 'coding_bug_fix_request';
00034| const ROLE_EXPECTATION = 'coding_expectation_cue';
00035| const SPEC_EDGES = new Set(['.', ',', ';', ':', '!', '?', '。', '，', '！', '？', '：', '।']);
00036| 
00037| const fill = (template, slots) => slots.reduce((text, [slot, value]) => text.split(`{${slot}}`).join(value), template);
00038| const isIdentifierChar = (character) => character !== undefined && /^[A-Za-z0-9_$]$/u.test(character);

00040| /** The first char offset of `needle` in `haystack` (char arrays), or -1. */
00041| function findChars(haystack, needle) {
00042|   for (let at = 0; at + needle.length <= haystack.length; at += 1) {
00043|     if (needle.every((character, index) => haystack[at + index] === character)) return at;
00044|   }
00045|   return -1;
00046| }
00047| 
00048| /** `chars[start..end]` without surrounding whitespace and sentence marks. */
00049| function trimmedSpan(chars, start, end) {
00050|   let from = start;
00051|   let to = end;
00052|   while (from < to && (isWhitespace(chars[from]) || SPEC_EDGES.has(chars[from]))) from += 1;
00053|   while (to > from && (isWhitespace(chars[to - 1]) || SPEC_EDGES.has(chars[to - 1]))) to -= 1;
00054|   return chars.slice(from, to).join('');
00055| }
00056| 
00057| /** The last identifier-bounded offset of `name` in `chars[..end]`, or -1. */
00058| function lastNameOffset(chars, name, end) {
00059|   const needle = Array.from(name);
00060|   for (let at = end - needle.length; at >= 0; at -= 1) {
00061|     if (needle.every((character, index) => chars[at + index] === character)
00062|       && !isIdentifierChar(chars[at - 1]) && !isIdentifierChar(chars[at + needle.length])) return at;
00063|   }
00064|   return -1;
00065| }

00067| /**
00068|  * Mirrors `fn expectation_request` in rust/src/agentic_coding/function_expectation.rs:
00069|  * `{module, language, cue: [start, end]}` for a bug report that names a
00070|  * module with a probe contract and states an expectation, or null.
00071|  * @param {string} task
00072|  */
00073| export function expectationRequest(task) {
00074|   if (!mentionsRole(ROLE_BUG_FIX, normalizePrompt(task))) return null;
00075|   const lower = lowerChars(Array.from(task));
00076|   let cue = null;
00077|   for (const surface of wordsForRole(ROLE_EXPECTATION)) {
00078|     const needle = Array.from(surface.toLowerCase());
00079|     const at = findChars(lower, needle);
00080|     if (at >= 0 && (cue === null || at < cue[0])) cue = [at, at + needle.length];
00081|   }
00082|   if (cue === null) return null;
00083|   for (const module of pathsIn(task)) {
00084|     const language = extensionLanguage(module);
00085|     const terms = language === null ? null : contract(language);
00086|     if (terms !== null && findChildValue(terms, 'probe') !== '') return { module, language, cue };
00087|   }
00088|   return null;
00089| }

00091| /** The checked call of the source's function the request names: `{name, call, command, expected}` or null. */
00092| function checkedCall(task, request, source) {
00093|   const terms = contract(request.language);
00094|   const prefix = findChildValue(terms, 'definition').split('{name}')[0];
00095|   const chars = Array.from(task);
00096|   let best = null;
00097|   for (const line of source.split('\n')) {
00098|     if (!line.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
00099|     const stated = signature(line);
00100|     if (stated === null) continue;
00101|     const at = lastNameOffset(chars, stated.name, request.cue[0]);
00102|     if (at >= 0 && (best === null || at > best.at)) best = { ...stated, at };
00103|   }
00104|   if (best === null) return null;
00105|   const after = trimmedSpan(chars, request.cue[1], chars.length);
00106|   const spec = after !== '' ? after : trimmedSpan(chars, best.at + Array.from(best.name).length, request.cue[0]);
00107|   const samples = findChildValue(terms, 'samples').split(/\s+/u).filter(Boolean).slice(0, best.parameters.length);
00108|   if (samples.length !== best.parameters.length) return null;
00109|   const expected = statedValue(spec.split(/\s+/u).filter(Boolean), spec, best.parameters, samples);
00110|   if (expected === null) return null;
00111|   const argumentsText = samples.join(', ');
00112|   return {
00113|     name: best.name,
00114|     call: `${best.name}(${argumentsText})`,
00115|     command: fill(findChildValue(terms, 'probe'),
00116|       [['name', best.name], ['module', request.module], ['arguments', argumentsText]]),
00117|     expected,
00118|   };
00119| }

00121| /** The latest shell result of the current turn, or null. */
00122| function latestRun(messages) {
00123|   let currentTurn = 0;
00124|   for (let index = messages.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
00125|     if (messages[index].role.toLowerCase() === 'user') {
00126|       currentTurn = index + 1;
00127|       break;
00128|     }
00129|   }
00130|   let latest = null;
00131|   for (let index = currentTurn; index < messages.length; index += 1) {
00132|     if (messages[index].role.toLowerCase() === 'tool' && resultCapability(messages, index) === Capability.Run) {
00133|       latest = plainText(messages[index].content);
00134|     }
00135|   }
00136|   return latest;

00139| /**
00140|  * Mirrors `fn plan_function_expectation_step` in
00141|  * rust/src/agentic_coding/function_expectation.rs.
00142|  * @param {string} task
00143|  * @param {Array<object>} messages
00144|  * @param {Array<string>} toolNames
00145|  */
00146| export function planFunctionExpectationStep(task, messages, toolNames) {
00147|   const request = expectationRequest(task);
00148|   if (request === null) return null;
00149|   const source = readSource(messages.slice(evidenceWindowStart(messages)), request.module);
00150|   if (source === null) {
00151|     const read = toolFor(toolNames, Capability.Read);
00152|     return read === null ? null : planOne(read, readArguments(request.module));
00153|   }
00154|   const checked = checkedCall(task, request, source);
00155|   if (checked === null) return null;
00156|   const raw = latestRun(messages);
00157|   if (raw === null) {
00158|     const shell = toolFor(toolNames, Capability.Run);
00159|     return shell === null ? null : planOne(shell, jsonText({ command: checked.command }));
00160|   }
00161|   const payload = normalizedPayload(raw);
00162|   if (payload === null || payload === undefined) return finalAnswer(render(checked.command, raw, task));
00163|   const observed = payload.trim();
00164|   const intent = observed === checked.expected ? 'function_expectation_holds' : 'function_expectation_fails';
00165|   const values = [['call', checked.call], ['path', request.module], ['observed', observed], ['expected', checked.expected]];
00166|   return finalAnswer(renderResponse(intent, detect(task), values) ?? renderResponse(intent, 'en', values));
00167| }

00185|   return question === null ? null : finalAnswer(question);
